mapper.select: SELECT source_table_name as sourceTableName, sum(case when is_active = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ddlChangeCnt, date_format(max(created_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') lastChangeTime FROM ssm_hot_table_ddl_change WHERE 1=1 and created_time > ADDDATE(now(), -3) GROUP BY source_table_name
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_hot_table_ddl_change ( source_table_name, is_active, created_time, created_by ) values ( #{sourceTableName}, #{isActive}, now(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update ssm_hot_table_ddl_change set is_active = #{isActive}, updated_time = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} where source_table_name = #{sourceTableName}
